Welcome to this beautifully appointed and spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence in the heart of Yaletown. This inviting home offers an exceptional balance of comfort and practicality, featuring a highly efficient layout that makes the most of every square foot. Both bedrooms are generously sized and thoughtfully placed on opposite sides of the home for added privacy, with the primary bedroom including its own ensuite for ease and comfort. Perfectly situated in an unbeatable central location, you’ll find shopping, dining, parks, and transit just steps away. Perfect urban living!
